definitions.gloss: chilly, slightly cold, cool enough to feel on the skin
definitions.explanation: A mild degree of cold felt on the skin, typically describing weather or air temperature. Conveys a sensation milder than 寒い (cold) — the kind of chill that makes you want a light jacket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今朝|けさ}→今朝：02877_kesa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肌寒|はだざむ}い。
⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{朝晩|あさばん}→朝晩：28955_asaban⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肌寒|はだざむ}く⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When autumn comes, mornings and evenings become chilly.

examples.japanese: {肌寒|はだざむ}い⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いていた→吹く：02445_fuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦カーディガン→カーディガン：04520_kaadigan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{羽織|はお}った→羽織る：13901_haoru⟧。
examples.english: A chilly breeze was blowing, so I threw on a cardigan.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
This word has two readings: {肌寒|はだざむ}い and {肌寒|はだざむ}い. Both are correct and widely used. This entry covers the はだざむい reading.

USAGE:
{肌寒|はだざむ}い describes a subtle, skin-level chill — not deep cold, but enough to notice. It is a seasonal word often associated with early autumn or late spring, when daytime is warm but mornings and evenings are cool.

Compared to ⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧ (cold), {肌寒|はだざむ}い is milder and more specific to the sensation on the skin. Compared to ⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧ (cool, refreshing), {肌寒|はだざむ}い has a slightly unpleasant nuance — not refreshing, but uncomfortably cool.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肌寒|はだざむ}い⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧: a chilly morning
- {肌寒|はだざむ}い⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧: a chilly breeze
- {肌寒|はだざむ}い⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧: the chilly season
- {肌寒|はだざむ}く⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel chilly
